name: How do I choose durable, low-maintenance materials for a rental property renovation?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose durable, low-maintenance materials for a rental property renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Selecting durable, low-maintenance materials is key to reducing long-term costs and tenant issues in a rental property. For flooring, consider luxury vinyl plank (LVP) or ceramic tile, which are resistant to wear and moisture. In kitchens and bathrooms, opt for solid surface countertops like quartz over more delicate options. Use washable, satin-finish paints for walls. Choose sturdy, easy-to-clean fixtures and cabinets. Prioritize materials known for longevity and ease of repair, as this minimizes turnover costs and tenant complaints, ensuring a better return on your investment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose materials like LVP or ceramic tile for flooring, quartz countertops, washable paints, and sturdy, easy-to-clean fixtures to ensure durability and low maintenance in rental properties.
